name: sports-anatomy-illustration
description: Evidence-backed medical illustration: patient and public science comics, teaching and patient-education illustrations, and research schematics, plus a sports anatomy module.

interface.shortDescription: Medical comics, teaching illustrations and research schematics, with sports anatomy.
interface.longDescription: Plan and produce three kinds of medical artwork — science comics for patients and the public, teaching and patient-education illustrations, and research schematics, mechanism figures and graphical abstracts — using real anatomical references, editable lettering, and separate production and human-review records. A sports anatomy module adds movement-phase specs checked against a muscle atlas, injury and rehab figures.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $sports-anatomy-illustration to choose the right output type (comic, teaching/education illustration, or research schematic), add sports anatomy where relevant, and complete the task with evidence and review records.
